project_type: GenomX Advisor research prototype: a plain-ES-module deterministic rule engine + browser UI (not touched here) alongside a Python research/ ML area. This task adds a self-contained ML/DL sub-project under research/kg/.
language: Python 3.12 for research/kg (engine/UI are JS, out of scope).
build_system: No packaging build for research/kg; scripts are run directly with the project venv interpreter at research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe. There is NO repo-wide Python build step. Derived artifacts are regenerated by scripts, not committed (research/kg/artifacts/ and research/kg/figures/ are gitignored).
test_framework: pytest if available in the venv; otherwise each module/test exposes an assert-based `if __name__ == "__main__"` runner invoked directly with the venv python. Tests live in research/kg/tests/. (The engine's JS tests use `node --test` and are unrelated.)
build_command: research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe research/kg/build_graph.py  (regenerates the Parquet artifacts; this is the closest thing to a 'build' for this sub-project)
test_command: research/kg/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest research/kg/tests  (fallback: run each tests/test_*.py directly with the venv python)
verification_instructions: 1) Run build_graph.py and confirm it prints node/edge counts matching data/adverse/index.json (drugs=1344, terms=4251, label pairs~=140677) and writes research/kg/artifacts/*.parquet + provenance.json. 2) Run the splits unit test and confirm zero train/test drug overlap and no held-out drug on any training label edge. 3) Run each module's test with the venv python. 4) Run run_all.py end-to-end on the classical stack and confirm it prints explicit SKIPPED lines for GNN (torch absent) and structure (RDKit absent) and still produces baseline tables + data/model/assoc_scores.parquet. Prefer real build/test commands; grep is NOT verification.
snapshot_or_generated_files: research/kg/artifacts/*.parquet and research/kg/artifacts/provenance.json are generated by build_graph.py; research/kg/figures/* by run_all.py; data/model/assoc_scores.parquet by export.py. All are regenerated, not hand-edited. artifacts/ and figures/ are gitignored (already added by the setup step).
environment_constraints: The venv at research/kg/.venv has scikit-learn 1.9.1, pandas 3.0.6, pyarrow 26.0.0, numpy 2.5.4, scipy 1.18.1, duckdb 1.5.6. It does NOT have torch, torch-geometric, rdkit, or matplotlib. Therefore: torch/PyG/RDKit/matplotlib MUST be lazy/optional imports; the classical pipeline must run fully without them; GNN and structure-fingerprint paths must raise a clear install message only when explicitly invoked, and run_all.py must skip-and-say. Do NOT install torch/PyG/rdkit (heavy, and PyG needs a separate wheel step) unless explicitly asked. Use the venv python by its path; shell rule denies commands starting with '& '. data_raw/pubchem/ does NOT exist, so structure features always fall back to learned embeddings here.
contribution_requirements: From .kiro/steering/product.md (NON-NEGOTIABLE): no numeric safety score; model predictions are research output shown separately and NEVER override rules or set a rule category; never invent clinical facts/citations/evidence (use [cite: verify] placeholders and labeled integration points); licences ClinPGx CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribute, share-alike, non-commercial), SIDER and TG-GATEs licences to be verified and noted in the model card. From .kiro/steering/tech.md: Python 3.12, fixed seeds, drug-wise cold-start splits, report CIs. Do NOT modify engine/, frontend/, or research/models/. Only ADD under research/kg/ and write to data/model/.
key_patterns: Follow research/models/random_forest_model.py and research/splits.py: function-based modules (not classes unless needed), concise docstrings, and `[module.func] ...` print-logging on every significant step (e.g. print(f"[rf.load_dataset] loaded {len(df)} rows")). Use a short module prefix per file: build_graph->`kg.build`, splits->`kg.splits`, baselines->`kg.base`, metrics->`kg.metrics`, gnn->`kg.gnn`, ablations->`kg.abl`, error_analysis->`kg.err`, export->`kg.export`, run_all->`kg.run`. Fixed seed default 42.
relevant_files: data/adverse/drug/*.json (SIDER per-drug positives; 1344 files; schema in plan.md)
data/guidelines/index.json (guidelines[].drugs[].drugId x genes[]; 217 guidelines, 41 genes, 208 drugs)
data/gene_catalog.json (41 gene symbols = KG gene nodes)
data/genes.json (engine gene vocab, 21 entries; NOT used for KG nodes)
data/tggates/index.json (127 compounds, scalar fold features + mask)
data/sources.json (licence/provenance strings for the model card)
research/kg/.agents/plan.md (full schemas + signatures + Parquet table specs)
directory_structure: research/kg/ holds all new code: build_graph.py, splits.py, baselines.py, metrics.py, gnn.py, ablations.py, error_analysis.py, export.py, run_all.py, requirements.txt, METHODS.md, PROCESS.md, README.md, MODEL_CARD.md; research/kg/tests/ holds pytest files; research/kg/artifacts/ holds generated Parquet + provenance.json (gitignored); research/kg/figures/ holds generated figures (gitignored); research/kg/.venv/ is the interpreter env; research/kg/.agents/ holds plan.md + this task's FEAT artifacts + the loop review.json. data/model/ (new, empty) receives assoc_scores.parquet. Read research/kg/.agents/plan.md FIRST for exact observed JSON schemas and planned Parquet schemas.
